question: When the Mac is in dark mode, should a starter Button you dropped change to dark colours?
context: The starter Button now matches the variants mock's light cells. The mock also draws dark cells, and today the Button keeps its light colours in dark mode.

options.label: Keep the colours you dropped
options.summary: A Button stays the blue, white and grey it was dropped in whatever the Mac is set to, like any picture you drew. Only the app around it goes dark.
pros: What you see is what you export or share
Matches how Figma and Photoshop treat a design
cons: In dark mode the Button does not match the mock's dark cells
options.mitigation: Recolour Accent, Surface or Text in Styles to make a dark version on purpose.

options.label: Follow the Mac appearance
options.summary: Each starter colour gets a dark version, so a dropped Button turns into the mock's dark look when the Mac goes dark and back when it goes light.
pros: Matches the mock in both schemes
A design made for both schemes comes for free
cons: An exported picture depends on the Mac's setting at the time
Styles need a second colour each, which is new to explain
options.mitigation: Export would say which appearance it used.
